<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">Anteater Riding a Unicycle While Juggling Bottles</title>
  <desc>An animated illustration of a giant anteater riding a unicycle down a sunny park path while juggling three spinning glass bottles.</desc>

  <defs>
    <!-- Sky & Atmosphere Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7ec8e3"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#bce6f5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fdf1d6"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <radialGradient id="sunGlow" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff9c4" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#ffe082" stop-opacity="0.7"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffe082" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <linearGradient id="hillFarGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#90c896"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#73b17c"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="hillNearGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6eb368"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4e944b"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="roadGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d8b98b"/>
      <stop offset="30%" stop-color="#c9a574"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a88456"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Anteater Fur & Markings -->
    <linearGradient id="furBodyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7a685b"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#5d4d42"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#46382f"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="furBackGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5a4b40"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3a2f27"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="tailGrad" x1="1" y1="0" x2="0" y2="0.6">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5c4c41"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#44372e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2c231d"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="snoutGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0.3">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#756357"/>
      <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#58493f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3b3029"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Unicycle Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="metalGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b0bec5"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#eceff1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#78909c"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="forkGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e53935"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ff6f60"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b71c1c"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Bottle Shapes & Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="greenBottleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1b5e20"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#43a047"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#2e7d32"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#144918"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="amberBottleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#bf360c"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#ff8f00"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#e65100"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8d2405"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="blueBottleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0d47a1"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#29b6f6"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#0277bd"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#093170"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Reusable Bottle Base Silhouette -->
    <g id="bottle-green">
      <path d="M -4,-28 L 4,-28 L 4,-17 C 4,-12 10,-9 10,-2 L 10,20 C 10,24 7,26 0,26 C -7,26 -10,24 -10,20 L -10,-2 C -10,-9 -4,-12 -4,-17 Z"
            fill="url(#greenBottleGrad)" stroke="#0f3d13" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <rect x="-4.5" y="-30" width="9" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#ffd54f" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="-9.5" y="-1" width="19" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#fff8e1" opacity="0.92"/>
      <line x1="-6.5" y1="4" x2="6.5" y2="4" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="-5" y1="8.5" x2="5" y2="8.5" stroke="#c62828" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M -6,-14 C -6,-10 -7.5,-7 -7.5,-2 L -7.5,19" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45"/>
    </g>

    <g id="bottle-amber">
      <path d="M -4,-28 L 4,-28 L 4,-17 C 4,-12 10,-9 10,-2 L 10,20 C 10,24 7,26 0,26 C -7,26 -10,24 -10,20 L -10,-2 C -10,-9 -4,-12 -4,-17 Z"
            fill="url(#amberBottleGrad)" stroke="#6d1b00" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <rect x="-4.5" y="-30" width="9" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#e0e0e0" stroke="#616161" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="-9.5" y="-1" width="19" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="6" r="4" fill="#ef6c00"/>
      <path d="M -6,-14 C -6,-10 -7.5,-7 -7.5,-2 L -7.5,19" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45"/>
    </g>

    <g id="bottle-blue">
      <path d="M -4,-28 L 4,-28 L 4,-17 C 4,-12 10,-9 10,-2 L 10,20 C 10,24 7,26 0,26 C -7,26 -10,24 -10,20 L -10,-2 C -10,-9 -4,-12 -4,-17 Z"
            fill="url(#blueBottleGrad)" stroke="#072554" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <rect x="-4.5" y="-30" width="9" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#ff7043" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="-9.5" y="-1" width="19" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#fffde7" opacity="0.92"/>
      <polygon points="0,1 1.6,4.5 5.4,4.8 2.5,7.3 3.4,11 0,9 -3.4,11 -2.5,7.3 -5.4,4.8 -1.6,4.5" fill="#0277bd"/>
      <path d="M -6,-14 C -6,-10 -7.5,-7 -7.5,-2 L -7.5,19" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Juggling Cascade Figure-8 Path (Period = 2.4s) -->
    <!-- Left hand throw (424,284) -> apex (472,96) -> Right hand catch (520,282) -> Right scoop (504,298) -> Right hand throw (498,282) -> apex (462,96) -> Left hand catch (408,286) -> Left scoop (418,302) -> back to (424,284) -->
    <path id="jugglePath"
          d="M 424,284 C 436,165 454,96 472,96 C 492,96 512,165 520,282 C 516,296 502,300 498,282 C 490,165 478,96 462,96 C 442,96 420,165 408,286 C 412,300 420,300 424,284 Z"
          fill="none"/>

      <rect x="0" y="512" width="800" height="88"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <circle cx="140" cy="110" r="95" fill="url(#sunGlow)"/>
  <circle cx="140" cy="110" r="34" fill="#fff59d"/>

        <ellipse cx="0" cy="12" rx="44" ry="18"/>
        <circle cx="-18" cy="4" r="20"/>
        <circle cx="12" cy="0" r="24"/>
        <circle cx="34" cy="10" r="15"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 3. PARALLAX HILLS & TREES -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0 0" to="-800 0" dur="14s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <path d="M 0,460 Q 150,390 320,445 T 640,440 T 960,445 T 1280,440 T 1600,460 L 1600,520 L 0,520 Z" fill="url(#hillFarGrad)"/>

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
